descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S17 No points bleed between a Hospital patient and a Nursing Home resident across switches, Back and reload

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes. (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.3; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U4 Editing one point and deleting another both work, in both modes, and the result is what is stored. (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U1 The panel is physician-authored only (PR #49): nothing is generated from the pre-round note, and saving a pre-round note on a patient with no points leaves the Important Points panel empty. … (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Default fixture: one Hospital patient, one Nursing Home resident, no points

When Add a point on the Hospital patient; switch to Nursing Home and open the resident; add a point there; switch back to Hospital, open the patient's editor; press Back once; reload and reopen

Then Each chart shows only its own point at every step

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: own point present and the other chart's point absent in every checkpoint (U7). cp1 also judges the Nursing Home empty-state copy under U1 (mustNotContain 'process notes with AI', known: TFA-92590; a plain Fail until oracleRules 5). Same-mode leaks are S26

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S17 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-12.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
